details.Title paint: your Pulse panel title in Glass, Etched or Halo paint, still, shimmering or drifting.
details.Tenure crest: a crest beside your Pulse panel title, under any paint. It levels up at 3, 6, 12 and 24 months.
details.Backdrop: original StreamPulse art behind your Pulse panel header, in your paint's colours, still or drifting.
details.Supporter card: your crest and paint on your Supporter card in settings.

onlyYou: Only you see these, in your own StreamPulse extension. Nothing is added to Twitch chat.

seenInChat.name: Seen in chat
seenInChat.detail: optional: your crest beside your name and your paint on it in Twitch chat, for other StreamPulse viewers. Off until you turn it on.
seenInChat.onlyYou: Title paint, the backdrop and the Supporter card show only in your own StreamPulse extension. Seen in chat is the one exception, and only if you turn it on: then other StreamPulse viewers see your crest and paint in chat. People without StreamPulse always see normal Twitch chat.
